Remote (India). Notice period: 30 days.

Experienced iOS developer focused on building performant, user-friendly mobile experiences using Swift, SwiftUI and Combine within Agile teams.

iOS Developer, Bluefin Logistics — Jul 2024 - Present
Built and shipped a parcel tracking module using SwiftUI and Combine that reduced UI latency by 40% on average and improved delivery status update reliability. Implemented end-to-end offline sync for delivery manifests using Combine publishers to reconcile background updates, lowering failed sync incidents by 35%. Collaborated with product and QA via Jira and Confluence to iterate on features and automate regression checks.

Mobile Engineer, Wipro — May 2023 - Jun 2024
Led development of a client-facing ride-booking prototype using Swift and SwiftUI, integrating Combine-based networking and state management to streamline asynchronous flows. Worked in Agile sprints, maintaining user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira and documenting designs in Confluence. Optimized app startup and memory usage, improving launch time by 25% across supported devices.

iOS Developer, Ola — Oct 2021 - Apr 2023
Contributed to core iOS features in the consumer app using Swift and Combine for reactive event handling and SwiftUI for experimental UI components. Implemented modular screens and reusable components that reduced development time for new flows by 30%. Participated in daily Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming and release planning tracked in Jira and Confluence.

Skills: Swift, iOS, SwiftUI, Combine, Jira, Confluence, Agile

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
